The Skate Trail opens December 12! Lace up and take a spin on The Bentway’s iconic 220m figure-eight loop beneath the Gardiner. Skate beneath the city lights, experience Àdìrẹ on Ice, and check out our lineup of winter programs and events.

You must present a valid government-issued ID and sign a waiver to rent skates. This applies even if you are picking up skates during complimentary/free skate rental periods. 
Those under the age of 18 and/or those without a valid government issued ID will not be able to rent skates without their parent or legal guardian present.  
Rentals and concessions are cashless. We are only able to accept debit or credit cards. 

The Skate Trail is back for another winter beneath the Gardiner! From December 12, 2026 through February 28, 2027, lace up and cruise The Bentway’s 220m figure-eight trail. 

Come for a skate, stay for the art, programming and winter events happening throughout the season. Experience Àdìrẹ on Ice, join a weekly program, catch a DJ night, or return for one of our favourite seasonal traditions. 

Skate rentals are available on site. Please check our holiday and New Year hours before your visit.

Get answers to commonly asked questions
Skate Trail Hours

Over the holidays: December 12 to January 3

Skate rentals and skate sharpening available daily 12:00pm to 8:00pm.

Skate sharpening will have limited availability during these hours, please inquire with the Skate Rentals team on site.

The Concession Stand is open daily from 12:00pm – 8:30pm.

After the holidays: January 4 to February 28

Skate rentals will be available on Thursdays and Fridays from 5:00pm – 8:00pm and on Saturdays, Sundays, Holidays and PA Days, from 12:00pm – 8:00pm. Rentals will not be available Mondays to Wednesdays during this period.

Skate sharpening is available to pre-book on Monday to Wednesday, 5:15pm – 7:45pm, CLICK HERE to book. For availability outside of these hours, please inquire with the Skate Rentals team on site. 

The Concession Stand is open on Thursdays and Fridays from 5:00pm – 8:30pm and on Saturdays, Sundays, Holidays and PA Days from 12:00pm – 8:30pm. Concessions will not be available Mondays to Wednesdays during this period. 

Special Dates and Hours 

On the following dates, the skate trail will be open for extended hours. Skate rentals will be open during these hours until 8:00pm, and concessions will be open during these hours until 8:30pm. 

The final day for skating for the 2026/2027 winter season will be February 28, 2027.
